summary: Expanded the public-market universe around the AI accelerator/HBM/advanced-packaging capacity node by prioritizing US-listed suppliers that sit near qualification-sensitive chokepoints: outsourced advanced packaging/test capacity, HBM/AI package inspection and metrology, probe cards, automated semiconductor test, and high-purity materials/process consumables. These are research candidates only, not recommendations. The strongest near-node candidates in this pass are AMKR, ONTO, FORM, TER, and ENTG; all require follow-up checks on customer concentration, order durability, China/export-control exposure, capex timing, and whether AI/HBM revenue is incremental versus cyclical pull-forward.
